session_note: The 91st Iowa General Assembly spans 2025-2026; a bill not enacted in 2025 can still be alive at the start of 2026 (its own bill number persists), but the second year (2026 session) adjourned Sine Die on 2026-05-03, and there is no further carryover into a 92nd General Assembly. Bills with no recorded action reaching a floor vote by 2026-05-03 are dead; several data-center bills stalled in committee well before that date, consistent with Iowa's internal 'funnel' deadlines that require bills to advance out of committee/one chamber by a set date each session to remain eligible for further floor action. Iowa's official BillBook pages are JS-rendered and did not return history data via plain fetch, but the underlying legis.iowa.gov billTracking/billHistory JSON-backed endpoint (same official data source) did, and was used for every decision below.
